prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of the results with an option for the company to licence them, as this is standard for

content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence instead of company_owns_uni_academic_use. I need the engine to be something our developers can maintain and integrate. An option to licence means we might not get it, or we'd need to negotiate a licence separately. I should push for uni_owns_option_to_assign which gives us a path to ownership, or at minimum company_owns_uni_academic_use. 

Let me trade: accept 30-day review (give on publication) to get ip changed to uni_owns_option_to_assign - that's better than option_to_licence for our needs since we want to own and maintain it directly.
